title: Sheaf Ext of sheaves of modules on a scheme
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ be the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules on the underlying topological space of $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (the site of open subsets of $X$, coverings the open coverings, with the sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal O_X$), $D(\mathcal O_X)=D(\Mod(\mathcal O_X))$ its derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}:D(\mathcal O_X)^{\mathrm{op}}\times D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]: $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(K,L)=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(\mathcal K^\bullet,\mathcal I^\bullet)$ for a complex $\mathcal K^\bullet$ representing $K$ and a K-injective complex $\mathcal I^\bullet$ quasi-isomorphic to a complex representing $L$. For $K,L\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and an integer $i$, the *$i$-th sheaf Ext* is the $\mathcal O_X$-module

$$
\mathcal Ext^i_{\mathcal O_X}(K,L)\;:=\;\mathcal H^i\bigl(R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(K,L)\bigr),
$$

the $i$-th cohomology sheaf [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] of $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(K,L)$. For $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ one writes $\mathcal Ext^i_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)=\mathcal Ext^i_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F[0],\mathcal G[0])$, $\mathcal F[0]$ the complex with $\mathcal F$ in degree $0$ and $0$ elsewhere; it is functorial, contravariant in $\mathcal F$ and covariant in $\mathcal G$, through the functoriality of $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}$ and of $\mathcal H^i$.
